notes:
Snapshot of needs and engineering notes:
- Business: legacy broadcast + print OCR, audio transcripts, long-form PDFs. Primary persona: content discovery for editors and legal review teams.
- Scale: customer estimates ~10M source items -> ~30-60M chunks depending on chunk policy. Need guidance on index shard sizing and approximate replica count for HA.
- Latency targets: retrieval p95 <= 350ms, end-to-end query (retrieve + rerank + return) p95 <= 700ms for editor UX; legal e-discovery can tolerate higher latency.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost-per-query (avg) $0.01 - $0.03. Will trade accuracy for cost on high-volume editorial queries.
- Chunking: currently testing two strategies: fixed-token chunks (2048 tokens) with 20% overlap vs semantic-chunking by paragraph/scene boundaries (~300-1500 tokens). SE note: semantic chunks reduce false positives on long narratives but increase index count unpredictably. Propose hybrid: larger coarse chunks for ANN retrieval, then chunk-slicing and reranker on top.
- Reranker approach: prefer cascade: fast bi-encoder (approx) for top-K -> cross-encoder for final top-5. Need to tune K vs cost/latency. Initial tuning sessions showed cross-encoder p95 latency ~160-220ms per query for single-document inputs on target infra; with 5-doc rerank pushes latency. Options discussed: quantize reranker, distill small cross-encoder, or use candidate scoring + re-ranking only for legal workflows.
- Embeddings model: interest in open 8k-context models; also evaluating Redwood-verified smaller embedding models for cost. Concern: representation stability across transcripts (ASR noise). Need embedding post-processing (stopwords, punctuation normalization).
- ANN choices: preference for HNSW for low-latency retrieval; consider IVF/PQ for lower RAM footprint at cost of recall. Need Redwood guidance for tuning efSearch/efConstruction at 40M vectors.
- Caching & batching: plan to use query result caching for repeated editorial lookups (prefix caching), and batching for nightly reindexes.
- Observability: want per-route token/cost latency dashboards, and reranker quality metrics (MRR, NDCG) tied to prompt sets. Redwood Optimize suggestions expected.
- Security: VPC (private control plane) + customer KMS, immutability of audit logs. Data residency: primary NA region, legal team needs EU residency for a subset.
- Quote from CTO: "We need predictable SLOs for editorial UX; if reranker kills latency at scale, the UX dies."
- Next immediate technical tasks: set chunking prototype (2048-fixed vs semantic), run an A/B on retrieval recall at K=50/100, measure reranker cost/latency for top-5. SE to provide ETA on sample ingest script and cost projection for 1M-doc pilot.
- Risks: index growth exceeds RAM assumptions -> need sharding + cold storage plan; ASR noise reduces embedding quality; procurement timeline uncertain (legal review in progress).
summary: Enterprise media archive (Lodestar) evaluating Redwood for large-scale RAG search. Focus on embeddings + reranker cascade to hit latency and cost targets for editors and legal reviewers. POC scoped for 1M docs -> ~40M chunks; next is finalize chunking policy and reranker thresholds.
